params.name: attributeId
params.description: Numeric ID of the Visitor ID attribute

params.name: attributeValue
params.description: Value to look up (URL-encode special characters)

params.name: prettyName
params.description: When true, returns user-friendly attribute names; when false, returns numeric IDs

params.name: searchPriority
params.description: JSON array controlling search order. Defaults to ["live","historical"]. Options: ["live"], ["historical"], or ["live","historical"]

params.name: responseFilters
params.description: JSON array of up to 150 attribute IDs to include in response. Omit to return all attributes.

items.docs: Retrieves the full visitor profile for a specific visitor identified by a Visitor ID attribute value. Supports live data, historical data, or both. Returns audience memberships, badges, and all configured attribute values. Maximum of 150 attribute IDs can be filtered per request.

items.docs: Retrieves the historical visitor profile for a specific visitor. Searches historical data only (no live data). Historical data is available after a 30-minute waiting period. Maximum of 150 attribute IDs can be filtered per request. The searchPriority parameter is not available for this endpoint.
